content.text: How to Watch and Listen to the PacersHow to Watch and Stream the Indiana PacersFanDuel Sports Network is the TV and streaming home of the Indiana Pacers. FanDuel Sports Network will broadcast 72 regular season games and all four preseason games this season. The network’s coverage also includes live pregame and postgame shows.Here is how to watch and stream Pacers games on FanDuel Sports Network in 2025-26:Subscribe to FanDuel Sports Network to stream the PacersLocal fans can purchase a streaming subscription via the FanDuel Sports Network app or by visiting FanDuelSportsNetwork.com. Fans can purchase a season pass, monthly, or annual streaming package. Individual games are also available for purchase once live coverage begins. The FanDuel Sports Network app is available for download on many devices and on several living-room/connected-device platforms. View the full list of supported devices here.Subscribe NowPrime Video: Local Prime Video customers can sign up to stream FanDuel Sports Network as an add-on subscription. Visit Amazon.com/FDSN to subscribe.Watch the Pacers on FanDuel Sports Network with a TV provider: FanDuel Sports Network is widely available on cable, satellite, and streaming providers, including DIRECTV, Fubo, Spectrum, Xfinity, Metronet, U-verse, Mediacom Xtream. Visit GetMyHomeTeams.com for options in your zip code. If you receive FanDuel Sports Network through your provider, you can stream games on the FanDuel Sports Network app or at FanDuelSportsNetwork.com at no extra cost by signing in with your provider credentials.Over-the-air TV channel(s): A select number of FanDuel Sports Network’s game broadcasts are also shown on local over-the-air channels. Please check the broadcast schedule for more details. In addition, these select games will stream for free on PlutoTV and Prime Video.Frequently Asked QuestionsIn what areas are Pacers games televised on FanDuel Sports Network?Pacers games are available on FanDuel Sports Network throughout central, southern and northeast Indiana, downstate Illinois, eastern Missouri, Iowa, and Kentucky. Fans outside the regional TV territory can subscribe to the NBA’s out-of-market League Pass package to view games.On what devices is the FanDuel Sports Network app available?The FanDuel Sports Network app is available for download on most iOS devices, on most Android devices, and on most Windows PCs and tablets. It is also available on several living room/connected-device platforms. View a full list of supported operating systems here.How do I add the FanDuel Sports Network channel on Prime Video?Prime Video customers can add the FanDuel Sports Network channel by taking these steps:Using a web browser:Visit amazon.com/channels.Search for or select the FanDuel Sports Network channelSelect a subscription planComplete checkout processOn your device:Open the Prime Video appSearch for or select the FanDuel Sports Network channelSelect a subscription planComplete checkout processAll live events are accessible on the live and upcoming row as users scroll down the main Prime Video home page.Have a question about FanDuel Sports Network?For customer support, visit help.fanduelsportsnetwork.com.How do I watch the Pacers if I live outside the Pacers TV territory?Fans who live outside the Pacers’ home TV territory defined by the NBA can subscribe to NBA League Pass, the league’s out-of-market package.Radio ListingsBelow is a list of radio stations where you can listen to Pacers games:107.5 the Fan & 93.5 FM, Indianapolis (Flagship)WNDI FM 95.3 SullivanW287BC FM 105.3, WPGW AM 1440, WPGW 100.9 FM PortlandWZBD FM 92.7 BerneWLTI AM 1550 New CastleWXVW AM 1450 and WXVW FM 96.1 JeffersonvilleWKJG AM 1380 and WKJG FM 100.9 Fort WayneWSLM AM 1220 and FM 97.9 SalemWAXL FM 103.3 Santa ClausWORX FM 96.7 MadisonWGCL 96.1 FM and 1370 AM BloomingtonWWBL FM 106.5 WashingtonWYFX FM 106.7 Mt.
